operations.name: create_or_update_members_area_member
operations.description: Create or update a members area member without a password. New members receive a password setup email. Existing active members keep their password, sessions, two-factor settings and current access groups. Inactive, blocked and administrator accounts cannot be updated. No login credentials are returned. Enrollment delivery is queued; check enrollmentFailed and enrollmentQueued in the response.

operations.description: Create or update an email contact. Creates or updates an email contact and supports legacy opt-in form submissions.

operations.description: Subscribe an email contact. Subscribes an email address to a FunnelCockpit email tag. This endpoint is also used by public opt-in flows.

operations.name: assign_email_tag
operations.description: Assign an email tag to a contact.

operations.description: List CRM contacts. Returns CRM contacts for a CRM.

operations.description: Create or update a CRM contact. Creates or updates a CRM contact. Lead group assignment requires the CRM owner’s valid private API key in the Authorization header. Public submissions ignore lead group assignments. Existing assignments are preserved.

operations.name: list_webinars
operations.description: List webinars. Returns webinars for a valid private API key. For legacy compatibility, missing or invalid API keys return HTTP 200 with an empty body.

operations.name: list_webinar_viewers
operations.description: List webinar viewers. Returns webinar viewers for a webinar.

operations.name: list_webinar_dates
operations.description: List upcoming webinar dates. Returns upcoming webinar dates.
